_about: The campaign plan, in order. Each goal has a RAM-detectable 'done' so runs can be scored without a human. 'verified' marks addresses confirmed on the real ROM; the rest are pret/pokered claims to confirm with `pokeagent hex find` or a probe before the planner relies on them. The explorer demo currently hardcodes the first four; a later directive makes it read this file.

goals.name: Withdraw the POTION from the bedroom PC
Get the starter from Oak's table

where.trigger: grass at the top edge of PALLET_TOWN 0x00 (one-time: Oak walks you to the lab 0x28)
where.balls: three balls on the table in 0x28; the YES/NO box names the pokemon

goals.notes: nickname prompt -> NO; sweep all three starters and keep per-starter stats

goals.name: Win the first rival battle in the lab
goals.notes: wIsInBattle 0xD057 read 2 (trainer) for the whole fight; a loss warps you home. Rules so far: FIGHT, move 1.

goals.name: Walk Route 1 north to Viridian City

where.exit: north edge of PALLET_TOWN 0x00 -> ROUTE_1 0x0C -> VIRIDIAN_CITY 0x01

goals.notes: first wild battles in the grass; RUN or FIGHT

goals.name: Pick up OAK'S PARCEL at the Viridian Mart clerk

where.spot: the clerk; talking to him hands over the parcel the first time

goals.name: Bring the parcel back to Oak, receive the POKeDEX
goals.notes: pokedex flag believed in wd74b bit 5 (unverified); START menu text is the reliable check

goals.name: Buy POKe BALLs at the Viridian Mart
Catch a wild pokemon on Route 1 or 22
goals.notes: needs battle menu reading: enemy HP low first helps

goals.name: Heal at the Viridian Pokemon Center
goals.notes: party HP/max HP addresses to learn (pokered: wPartyMon1HP 0xD16C, wPartyMon1MaxHP 0xD18D, unverified)

goals.name: Train the starter to level 8+
goals.notes: wPartyMon1Level believed 0xD18C (unverified); measure XP per minute in Route 1 grass vs Route 22

goals.name: Cross Route 2 and Viridian Forest to Pewter City
goals.notes: trainers in the forest are forced battles when they see you; Bug Catchers; Pikachu is here

goals.name: Beat Brock for the Boulder Badge
goals.notes: wObtainedBadges 0xD356 bit 0 (unverified); Charmander needs level ~12 or a Butterfree; this is where move choice matters

detectors.bag_has_item: 0xD31D count, then (id, qty) pairs from 0xD31E - VERIFIED
detectors.battle: 0xD057 - VERIFIED as nonzero (2) during the trainer battle
detectors.start_menu_has: decode the START menu from the tile map 0xC3A0 - VERIFIED charmap
